frame.summary: EAC #ffe1d6 is closed (1 component, largest used). PCA length 56.1 mm. The min-projection side meets exterior air on 447 end-band voxels; the max side meets it on 109. The cap plane fits that side's face of the closed solid (3310 surface voxels meeting exterior air and facing along the canal, in-plane radius 13.4 mm). The lateral vector runs from the EAC centroid to that face (alignment with the long axis 0.97). The fitted plane is 20.7° from that vector. #640000 (138892 voxels) lies entirely beyond the EAC (0.1 mm clear) and is the TMJ side. The anterior plane is the outer tangent of that wall (5593 voxels, in-plane radius 24.9 mm), held at 90° to the cap plane. Mask 3 drops cortex on the TMJ side of it. Volume laterality is right and was not used.

notes: Mask 3 drops 7.41 cm² on the TMJ side of the anterior plane.
Mask 2 keeps almost all of mask 1, so the exterior bone around the cap is one connected sheet.
Counts are the smoothed surface shown in the tuner. Save mask writes the exact live values.
